"a bigthank you" from kk magazine commitee the committee of kk parish magazine would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone in the community and beyond who turned out in huge numbers to attend and support the very special milestone occasion of the 20th edition of parish magazine launch at ireland west airport on sunday 25th october. thanks to the management and staff of the airport who worked so hard hosting the event for us, to all our kind sponsors who donated fantastic prizes for our raffle, to the brilliant musicians and our mc who entertained everyone on the night, the photographers who captured all the special moments, and all who helped the committee out in any way on the night and recently, it is greatly appreciated. the launch will be televised on tv ireland show sky channel 588 in december. the bumper edition magazines are now on sale locally in kilkelly in kilmovee. thanks to our great community for their continued support, it is greatly appreciated by our committee. kilmovee shamrocks gaa & lgfa clubs annual dinner dance takes place in durkins, ballaghaderreen on saturday 14th november 2026. final tickets on sale at the clubhouse in kilmovee on sunday 1st november from 4pm to 5pm. bus available. please contact
